_comment: Hierarchical LP AllGather on hetero. 3 heterogeneous hosts (4/4/6 GPUs, tapered uplinks, single-homed host B) -> 5-node asymmetric coarse graph. Uplinks < GPUs everywhere, so egress staging is forced; hosts A and C have no GPU owning both T0 and T1, so any transit through them is RELAYED and exercises the forward-dwell constraint. LP-hierarchical twin of the MILP inputs for A/B: identical except formulation=2 and the LP's milp_chunking is unused. SLOWEST_LINK keeps every coarse link at >= 1 chunk/epoch (occupancy 1: no multi-epoch legs, no cut-through optimism). switch_copy is forced off at MILP levels anyway (copy happens at hosts). Outputs: Schedules/<prefix>_flat.json (+ _coarse/_identities/_intra side outputs). See teccl/hierarchy/milp_design.md.
